note: Model guidance for the assessment. Tiers are matched on the model id (case-insensitive substring), so new versions of a family are classified without editing this file. Update `recommended` when a newer frontier model is available in the client.

frontier.effect: full quality: interpretation of findings, diagram redraw, recommendations and localization behave as designed

reduced.effect: noticeably weaker on the analysis stages: shallower key issues, more generic recommendations, more diagram audit retries, skipped verification steps

unsuitable.effect: small models skip stage steps and misread the skill contract; use them only for smoke tests of the tooling

effort.note: On Kiro CLI the per-model effort setting (`chat.modelDefaults.<model>.output_config.effort`) matters almost as much as the model; keep it at high or xhigh for the analysis stages.
